articles.title: Fire Breaks Out in Smallbridge, Rochdale
articles.excerpt: A fire broke out in Smallbridge, Rochdale, on Friday evening, prompting a response from firefighters who worked through the night to extinguish the flames and monitor the aftermath.
articles.content_html:
A fire broke out in an open area on Spring Mill Walk in Smallbridge, Rochdale, at around 8:15pm on Friday, July 24. Firefighters worked throughout the night to extinguish the flames, which involved a large quantity of waste.

Aerial images captured the scene, showing significant plumes of black smoke visible from across Rochdale as the fire spread. Fire crews remained on site until around 1pm on Saturday, damping down hotspots and monitoring the aftermath.

Pictures taken by a drone revealed a large area of scorched earth and debris left behind by the fire. Officials from the Environment Agency were also called in, and the local council was alerted due to the involvement of waste in the incident.

The incident has raised concerns regarding environmental safety, and investigations into the cause of the fire are likely to follow.
